title: Asian Para Games: Manginsay-Redulla tandem takes silver in table tennis
summary: The tandem of Lhey Manginsay and Wilfred Redulla delivered a table tennis silver medal for the Philippines in the 5th Asian Para Games, Thursday in Nagoya.
